doc: Cut a list at its first element of `Z`.
name: DisequalityDispersion.Menger.exists_prefix_until
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} (Z : Finset.{0} α) (l : List.{0} α),
  (∃ z, And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} l z) (Membership.mem.{0, 0} Z z)) →
    ∃ l₁ z,
      And (List.IsPrefix.{0} (HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} l₁ (List.cons.{0} z List.nil.{0})) l)
        (And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} Z z) (∀ (v : α), Membership.mem.{0, 0} l₁ v → v ∉ Z))

source.code:
/-- Cut a list at its first element of `Z`. -/
theorem exists_prefix_until (Z : Finset α) :
    ∀ (l : List α), (∃ z ∈ l, z ∈ Z) → ∃ l₁ z, (l₁ ++ [z]) <+: l ∧ z ∈ Z ∧ ∀ v ∈ l₁, v ∉ Z
  | [], h => by simp at h
  | a :: l, h => by
      by_cases ha : a ∈ Z
      · exact ⟨[], a, ⟨l, rfl⟩, ha, by simp⟩
      · have : ∃ z ∈ l, z ∈ Z := by
          obtain ⟨z, hz, hzZ⟩ := h
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
          · exact absurd hzZ ha
          · exact ⟨z, hz, hzZ⟩
        obtain ⟨l₁, z, ⟨t, ht⟩, hz, hl₁⟩ := exists_prefix_until Z l this
        refine ⟨a :: l₁, z, ⟨t, ?_⟩, hz, ?_⟩
        · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, ht]
        · intro v hv
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv
          · exact ha
          · exact hl₁ v hv
